p.src: 1  Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

en: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
u.src: 1  Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

p.src: 2  Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.

en: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.
u.src: 2  Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.

p.src: 3  Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

ja: しかし、その両者よりも幸いなのは、まだ
en: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
u.src: 3  Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

p.src: 4  Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.

ja: また私は、あらゆる労苦と
へのねたみから生じるのを
en: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.
u.src: 4  Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.

p.src: 5  The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.

en: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.
u.src: 5  The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.

p.src: 6  Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.

ja: いっぱいは、労苦して風を追う
en: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.
u.src: 6  Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.

p.src: 7  Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

en: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.
u.src: 7  Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

p.src: 8  There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

ja: もいない者がいる。その人のすべての
しない。「私はいったい誰のために
しい。実に、痛ましい務めだ。
en: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.
u.src: 8  There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

p.src: 9  Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

en: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
u.src: 9  Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

p.src: 10  For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

ja: こすことができる。しかし、
en: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
u.src: 10  For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

p.src: 11  Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?

en: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?
u.src: 11  Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?

p.src: 12  If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

ja: つ撚りの綱は、簡単には
en: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
u.src: 12  If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

p.src: 13  Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.

ja: もはや忠告を受け入れることも知らない、年老いた愚かな王よりも、
en: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.
u.src: 13  Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.

p.src: 14  For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.

en: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.
u.src: 14  For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.

p.src: 15  I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.

ja: が、王の後継者となったもう一人の
en: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.
u.src: 15  I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.

p.src: 16  There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

ja: は数え切れなかった。それでも、
en: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
